newsitem.title: USA: Dell soars, boosts other PC maker shares.
newsitem.headline: Dell soars, boosts other PC maker shares.

text.p: Shares of Dell Computer Corp soared after the direct PC maker reported stronger than expected earnings, fueling a surge in PC stocks as investors viewed Dell's numbers as indicative of strong PC demand.

Dell's shares climbed 8-7/8 to 108-1/2 in heavy trading. Analysts said that Dell not only beat the First Call estimate of $0.93 a share but also beat the "whisper" numbers. One whisper number was $1.00 a share and another was $1.05 a share, analysts said. Dell reported $1.08 a share. Other PC shares jumped. Compaq Computer Corp rose 4-5/8 to 101-5/8, and Gateway 2000 Inc gained 3-3/8 to 74-1/2.
Gateway is also expected to unveil an aggressive attack on the corporate market later Wednesday. International Business Machines Corp added 1-3/4 to 175-1/4.

"What happens when a bellwether like Dell turns numbers in like this, people assume the demand climate is generally good," said Mark Specker, a SoundView Financial analyst. But he added that Dell is likely taking market share from some of the more troubled PC makers such as AST Research Inc.
"They are growing at about three times faster than the rest of the industry as a whole," Specker said. "It's blistering." Dell also announced a two-for-one stock split.
